note: The decoded gate row this recipe reached when it shipped. npm run qa:cover-recipes re-renders it through motion.mjs cover and fails when median d or the moving share leaves +-15 % of this row, seamLocal leaves TARGET, the file passes 2 MiB or the render exits non-zero. Measured on headless Chrome's software rung (SwiftShader) and libwebp 1.6.0.

treatment.request: A README motion cover for LitGrok that shows work moving through gates.
treatment.idea: Dots lap three rings and every crossing at the gate lights the next cell of a ledger under the name.
treatment.recipeReason: A small system beside a still name shows checking without words.

layers.slow: Dashed ring overlays turn a quarter lap per loop.
layers.mid: The core breathes once per loop and rings out on every bar.
layers.beat: Gate flashes and dot swells at each crossing; ledger cells light and decay.

system.rule: One orbit rule with whole laps per ring.
system.copies: Eight dots on three rings and sixteen ledger cells.
system.offset: Each dot's start angle k / n on its ring.

treatment.ambition: The ledger and the gates keep a steady pulse while the word stays perfectly still.
